messages:
sara: Noticing a batch of GPU nodes in ap-south-1 stuck at 'ProvisioningPending' after the egress prefix-list cutover earlier. Anyone else seeing KMS handshake errors?
ben: Yup, saw the same. We rolled the new prefix-list that replaces the permissive NAT range with a strict customer-only list.
sara: Right — keystore-proxy can't reach kms.redwood.internal over NAT because the prefix-list unintentionally dropped the NAT gateway CIDR.
ops-bot: infra-deploy: prefix-list update applied to ap-south-1 at 2026-03-23T10:14Z (change: PL-2026-089).
li: paste logs: ```
keystore-proxy WARN: tls handshake failed to kms.redwood.internal:443 -> source=10.12.48.7 dest=13.251.9.23:443 err="connection reset by peer"
node-join[agent]: state=ProvisioningPending reason="kms handshake timeout" attempts=3
```
sara: Because of the role boundary restriction, only infra-admins can edit the prefix-list. I don't have that role to add the NAT CIDR back.
ben: Immediate mitigation: created a short-lived route in the warm-pool route-table to point KMS traffic to a fallback NAT (nat-fallback-ap-south) that is in the approved prefix-list. Command: `infractl route add --rtb warm-pool-ap-south --dest 13.251.9.0/24 --target nat-fallback-ap-south --expires 45m`
ops-bot: monitor: warm-pool-ap-south healthy_nodes: 6 -> 38 (12m) :white_check_mark:
sara: Recovery looks good, but we burned ~9 GPU-hours due to retries and reboots. Cost hit ~USD 1.7k for the incident window (estimate).
ben: We should not rely on humans to add temporary routes. Proposal: change gating on prefix-list PRs to validate keystore egress paths (NAT CIDRs) and auto-fail rollouts that remove them.
li: Also request: add a cross-team allowlist mechanism that infra-ops can trigger without needing infra-admin role, but with an automatic audit record.
sara: For the compliance trail: I created an exception record and attached it to change PL-2026-089. compliance-bot, please ingest.
compliance-bot: exception-record created id=EXC-2026-445; linked change=PL-2026-089; expires=2026-03-23T11:00Z. Audit log will include operator and reason.
ben: Follow-ups: (1) small e2e test in the PR that spins up a warm-pool node and verifies KMS decrypt before merge, (2) a runbook for rapid route fallback that non-admin ops can invoke via infra-run command, (3) update prefix-list review checklist to include NAT CIDR dependency mapping.
li: I'll open RED-IF-5567 and assign eng-infra + eng-platform for the checklist and gating.
sara: Tagging: @eng-infra, @eng-platform — please triage.
ben: Pre-PR quick fix: will add the NAT CIDR back to PL-2026-089 with a note and a canary roll (5% subnets) to prevent global blast radius.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-23T12:00Z.
li: Thanks y'all. We'll also add a metric alert: if >5% of warm-pool nodes are ProvisioningPending for >3m during a prefix-list rollout, auto-create a route fallback and notify on-call.
sara: Filing incident: https://issues.internal/RED-IF-5567 "ap-south prefix-list removed NAT CIDR -> keystore decrypt failures and GPU warmup costs". Attach logs and cost estimate.
ben: Closing the loop: PR checklist update and infra-runbook draft due EOD tomorrow.
